Next, we ensemble eight likelihood-trained models for both
WMT’14 English-German and WMT’14 English-French
and compare to previous work which also reported ensem-
ble results. For the former, we also show the result when
ensembling 10 models. Table 2 shows that we outperform
the best current ensembles on both datasets.
